name: loop_expand_recursive_positional
template: {% for x in [2] recursive %}{{x}}{% if x %}{{loop(*[[x-1]],**{})}}{% endif %}{% endfor %}

name: loop_expand_recursive_keyword
template: {% for x in [2] recursive %}{{x}}{% if x %}{{loop(**{'iterable':[x-1]})}}{% endif %}{% endfor %}

name: loop_else
template: {% for user in users %}[{{ user.name }}]{% else %}empty{% endfor %}

name: loop_core_metadata
template: {% for item in users %}[{{ loop.index0 }},{{ loop.index }},{{ loop.revindex0 }},{{ loop.revindex }},{{ loop.first }},{{ loop.last }},{{ loop.length }},{{ loop.depth0 }},{{ loop.depth }}:{{ item.name }}]{% endfor %}

name: loop_metadata_in_expressions_and_collection_literals
template: {% for item in ['a', 'b'] %}{{ loop.index + 10 }}{% if loop.first or loop.last %}!{% endif %}{% endfor %}

name: loop_neighbor_items_expose_struct_attributes_and_boundary_undefined
template: {% for item in users %}[{% if loop.previtem is defined %}{{ loop.previtem.name }}{% endif %}|{{ item.name }}|{% if loop.nextitem is defined %}{{ loop.nextitem.name }}{% endif %}|{{ loop.previtem is undefined }}|{{ loop.nextitem is undefined }}]{% endfor %}

name: loop_boundary_neighbor_attribute_access_is_undefined_error
template: {% for item in users %}{{ loop.previtem.name }}{% endfor %}

name: loop_neighbor_items_cover_list_tuple_and_unique_dict_keys
template: {% for item in [10, 20, 30] %}[{{ loop.previtem }}|{{ item }}|{{ loop.nextitem }}]{% endfor %}|{% for item in ('a', 'b') %}[{{ loop.previtem }}|{{ item }}|{{ loop.nextitem }}]{% endfor %}|{% for key in {'a': 1, 'a': 2, 'b': 3} %}[{{ loop.previtem }}|{{ key }}|{{ loop.nextitem }}]{% endfor %}

name: loop_neighbor_items_compose_in_native_expressions
template: {% for item in [10, 20, 30] %}{% if loop.previtem is defined and loop.nextitem is defined %}{{ loop.previtem + 0 }}/{{ item }}/{{ item + 0 }}/{{ loop.nextitem + 0 }}={{ loop.previtem + item + loop.nextitem }}{% else %}_{{ loop.previtem is undefined }}{{ loop.nextitem is undefined }}_{% endif %}{% endfor %}

name: loop_cycle_uses_index_and_evaluates_arguments
template: {% for item in [1, 2, 3] %}[{{ loop.cycle('odd', 'even') }}:{{ loop.cycle(item, item + 10) }}]{% endfor %}

name: loop_changed_tracks_scalar_and_multiple_arguments
template: {% for item in [1, 1, 2, 2] %}{{ loop.changed(item, item > 1) }}{% endfor %}

name: loop_changed_state_is_shared_between_call_sites
template: {% for item in [1, 2] %}{{ loop.changed(item) }}:{{ loop.changed(item) }};{% endfor %}

name: loop_changed_without_arguments_and_collection_equality
template: {% for item in [[1], [1], [2]] %}{{ loop.changed(item) }}{% endfor %}|{% for item in [1, 2] %}{{ loop.changed() }}{% endfor %}
